decisions.statement: The bare repositories are made ready before the source cache is filled.
The store is mounted read-only into everything but the server.
The pod's containers share one process namespace.
One copy runs at a time.
The old copy goes before the new copy starts.
The server runs the code out of the source cache the sidecar keeps current.
Where that code sits in the cache is asked of the index rather than spelled.

definition: the workload the cluster runs the transport as
